embeddings.text: A full-time student at a recognized institution is entitled to a 25% discount on municipal property tax for the apartment in which the student lives, for up to 6 years from the start of studies.
A reservist who served at least 20 reserve days in the previous calendar year is entitled to a 5% discount; 40 days or more entitle the reservist to a 10% discount.
Discounts under this policy are not combined: the higher discount applies.
The discount applies to an apartment of up to 120 square meters. A larger apartment receives the discount on the first 120 square meters only.
An applicant with outstanding municipal debt of more than 2,000 ILS is referred to the collection department before any discount is granted.
Applications submitted after 30 June 2026 are referred to the discounts committee.
A student who is also a reservist receives both discounts.
Applicants who meet none of the conditions above are rejected. Applications that meet a condition are approved at the applicable rate, and anything not decided is referred to the discounts committee.

R-005 · Start from no discount; the higher entitlement wins
When: always
Then: set discount_rate = 0
Source, paragraph 3: "the higher discount applies"

R-010 · Student discount of 25%
When: is_student = true AND years_since_start ≤ 6 years
Then: set discount_rate = max(discount_rate, 25)
Source, paragraph 1: "entitled to a 25% discount"

R-020 · Reservist discount of 5% for 20 to 39 days
When: reserve_days ≥ 20 days AND reserve_days < 40 days
Then: set discount_rate = max(discount_rate, 5)
Source, paragraph 2: "at least 20 reserve days in the previous calendar year is entitled to a 5% discount"

R-030 · Reservist discount of 10% for 40 days or more
When: reserve_days ≥ 40 days
Then: set discount_rate = max(discount_rate, 10)
Source, paragraph 2: "40 days or more entitle the reservist to a 10% discount"

R-100 · Reject: no entitlement
When: discount_rate = 0 percent
Then: reject: The applicant meets none of the discount conditions
Source, paragraph 8: "Applicants who meet none of the conditions above are rejected"

R-300 · Collection department: debt above 2,000
When: municipal_debt > 2,000 ILS
Then: refer: Outstanding municipal debt above 2,000 ILS is referred to the collection department
Source, paragraph 5: "outstanding municipal debt of more than 2,000 ILS is referred to the collection department"

R-310 · Discounts committee: submitted after 30 June
When: submission_date > 2026-06-30
Then: refer: Applications submitted after 30 June 2026 go to the discounts committee
Source, paragraph 6: "Applications submitted after 30 June 2026 are referred to the discounts committee"

R-410 · Flag: discount limited to 120 square meters
When: area_sqm > 120 sqm
Then: flag AREA_CAP_120: The discount applies to the first 120 square meters only
Source, paragraph 4: "A larger apartment receives the discount on the first 120 square meters only"

R-900 · Approve at the applicable rate
When: always
Then: approve: The application meets a discount condition
Source, paragraph 8: "Applications that meet a condition are approved at the applicable rate"
